                Arxiv151003522v1SourceEnrichedCodex.u x ∂Arxiv151003522v1SourceEnrichedCodex.μ =
              0 ∧
            ∫ (x : Arxiv151003522v1SourceEnrichedCodex.Torus),
                  Arxiv151003522v1SourceEnrichedCodex.drift x ∂Arxiv151003522v1SourceEnrichedCodex.μ =
